2.text: The bracelet of the most usual type is made to match the necklace.

3.text: It is a narrow strip of leather, with a single bead tied to one of the ends

4.text: (Fig. 189, a; Fig. 190, a, b). Very few Chukchee are seen without these bracelets

5.text: on at least one of their wrists. Some add an extra bead or wind the band

6.text: around twice. Arm-bands of a similar style are also worn (Fig. 190 a, b).

7.text: More ornamental bracelets are made of a string of large beads or of small

8.text: beads sewed in several rows on a strip of leather (Fig. 188, c, f). Bracelets

9.text: of iron and brass are also used (Fig. 189, b), though these are generally
